# QRCode.js

`qrcode.min.js` is QRCode.js 1.0.0 by davidshimjs, distributed under the MIT license in `qrcode.LICENSE`.

Source: https://www.npmjs.com/package/qrcodejs/v/1.0.0 (package artifact `qrcodejs-1.0.0.tgz`). The file is unchanged and its SHA-384 matches the SRI of the CDN asset previously used by the join page:

```
sha384-3zSEDfvllQohrq0PHL1fOXJuC/jSOO34H46t6UQfobFOmxE5BpjjaIJY5F2/bMnU
```

Served locally so guest QR rendering does not depend on a third-party CDN.

# jsQR

`jsQR.js` is the unchanged browser distribution of jsQR 1.4.0 from
https://www.npmjs.com/package/jsqr/v/1.4.0, licensed under Apache-2.0
(see `jsQR.LICENSE`). It is loaded on demand when native QR detection is
unavailable or fails. Camera frames are decoded in the browser and are not uploaded.
